scripts.db:status: cd backend && npx prisma migrate status
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:start && cd backend && npm run prisma:generate && npx prisma migrate deploy && npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:seed:run: cd backend && npx tsc prisma/seed.ts --esModuleInterop --module commonjs --target es2020 --outDir prisma/dist --skipLibCheck --types node && node prisma/dist/prisma/seed.js
scripts.db:seed:run:with-generate: npm run db:sync && npm run db:seed:run
scripts.db:sync: cd backend && npm run prisma:generate && npx prisma db push
